verdict.rationale: Teller offers webhooks for event notifications (teller-docs-7, teller-docs-17), but there is no evidence of a rules engine or automation-configuration capability where users can define conditional actions triggered by events — webhook delivery only notifies an external app, it doesn't let a user define trigger-action rules within Teller itself. missing for 10: any rule/condition builder, action templates, or automation configuration UI/API beyond raw webhook event delivery.
